name: Metamorphoser
source:
Metamorphoser is a 18+ sci-fi horror BL game project by supercircuit games originally for NaNoRenO 2016.

You play as trans boy college student Carter who meets a mysteriously alluring new student called Isaac and the two enter into a dangerous relationship. While trying to organise his feelings for Isaac, Carter hears about strange happenings around college: ghost stories, missing students, and odd reports of rotting flesh in the science lab… The closer he gets to figuring out Isaac, the closer he gets to being in serious danger. Will he survive to find out the truth? Or will he turn into just another story of a missing student?

[From [url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/metamorphoser]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《变形者》是supercircuit games为NaNoRenO 2016制作的18禁科幻恐怖BL游戏企划。

你将扮演跨性别男大学生卡特，他遇见神秘迷人的新生艾萨克，两人展开危险关系。卡特努力整理对艾萨克的感情时，听说校园里接连发生怪事：鬼故事、学生失踪，以及科学实验室出现腐烂肉体的奇怪报告……他越接近艾萨克，就越接近严重危险。他能活着揭开真相吗？还是会变成又一个失踪学生的故事？

[来源：[url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/metamorphoser]itch.io[/url]]
